name: Wall Sit
instructions: Lean your back flat against a wall.
Slide down until knees are bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold the position for the specified duration.
formTips: Press lower back firmly into the wall.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge Hold
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent and feet flat.
Extend one leg out straight.
Drive through non-extended heel to lift hips and hold position.

name: Isometric Calf Raise Hold
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Rise up onto toes as high as possible.
Squeeze calves and hold top position.
formTips: Distribute weight evenly across ball of foot.

name: Isometric Push-Up Hold
instructions: Assume a high push-up plank position.
Lower body halfway or just above ground.
Hold isometric position while keeping core rigid.
formTips: Maintain straight line from head to heels.

name: Overhead Pike Push-Up Hold
instructions: Set up in pike position with hips raised toward ceiling.
Lower head slightly toward floor.
Hold top or midpoint position overhead.
formTips: Maintain active shoulders pushing floor away.

name: Inverted Row / Pull-Up Hold
instructions: Pull chest to bar or inverted row station.
Hold peak contraction at top position with chin over bar/handles.
formTips: Keep chest open and core tight.

name: Dead Hang
instructions: Grip pull-up bar with overhand grip.
Hang freely with arms extended.
Relax body and allow spine to decompress.

name: Isometric Bicep Hold
instructions: Hold dumbbells or weight at a 90-degree elbow flexion angle.
Keep elbows locked at sides.
Squeeze biceps continuously.
commonMistakes: Lowering arms as fatigue sets in

name: Isometric Tricep Dip Hold
instructions: Mount dip station with arms locked out or at 90-degree bend.
Hold position steady with core tight.
formTips: Keep shoulders depressed away from ears.
commonMistakes: Dipping lower than shoulder flexibility allows

name: Forearm Plank
instructions: Rest on forearms and toes with elbows directly under shoulders.
Keep body in straight line from head to heels.
Brace core and hold position.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on side supported by forearm.
Stack feet and lift hips off ground until body forms straight line.
Hold for desired duration, then switch sides.
commonMistakes: Allowing hips to drop toward floor

name: Box Jumps
instructions: Stand facing plyo box in athletic stance.
Swing arms back, bend knees, and explode upward onto box.
Land softly on box with feet flat, absorb impact, and step down.
formTips: Step down rather than jumping off.
commonMistakes: Selecting too tall of a box

name: Broad Jumps
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Load hips back and swing arms backward.
Leap forward explosively for maximum distance, landing softly.
formTips: Absorb shock through full foot roll.

name: Pogo Jumps
instructions: Stand tall with feet narrow.
Bounce rapidly off balls of feet with minimal knee bend.
Minimize ground contact time.

name: Drop Jumps
instructions: Step off plyo box onto ground.
Upon landing, immediately jump straight up into air as high as possible.
Focus on minimal ground contact time.
formTips: Land balanced on balls of feet.
commonMistakes: Jumping off box instead of stepping off

name: Death Jumps (Drop to Lateral Bound)
instructions: Step off low box.
Upon ground impact, immediately bound laterally as far as possible.
Land softly on outside leg.
formTips: Transfer vertical force into lateral momentum rapidly.

name: Drop to 45° Cut Sprint
instructions: Step off box.
Absorb ground contact and immediately push off diagonally at a 45-degree angle.
Accelerate into a 5-10m sprint.
formTips: Plant outside foot firmly to cut.
Keep body angle low during departure.

name: Depth Jumps
instructions: Step off a 12-24 inch box.
React immediately upon touching ground to jump maximal height.
Land softly.
commonMistakes: Bending knees too deep on landing

name: Tuck Jumps
instructions: Stand upright.
Jump explosively high into air while pulling knees up to chest.
Extend legs quickly to land softly.
formTips: Bring knees to chest, not chest down to knees.

name: Single-Leg Bounds
instructions: Push off one leg and leap forward for maximum distance.
Land on same leg or alternate leg while maintaining forward momentum.
Repeat rhythmically.

name: Depth Drop Calf Hops
instructions: Step off low box onto floor.
Keep knees nearly stiff.
Rebound off ankles immediately using calf elasticity.

name: Plyo Push-Ups
instructions: Lower body into standard push-up.
Push off ground with maximum explosive power so hands leave floor.
Land softly with bent elbows and transition into next rep.

name: Medicine Ball Chest Passes
instructions: Hold medicine ball at chest height facing wall or partner.
Step forward and push ball forcefully outward.
Catch ball on rebound and absorb back to chest.
formTips: Follow through with arms fully extended.
commonMistakes: Lobbing ball instead of pressing horizontally

name: Plyo Pull-Ups
instructions: Pull up with maximum speed towards bar.
Release bar briefly at top peak momentum.
Re-grip bar instantly and lower down under control.

name: Explosive Overhead Medicine Ball Slams
instructions: Raise medicine ball overhead extending full body.
Flex core hard and slam ball down into floor with max effort.
Catch ball on bounce and repeat.
formTips: Use entire torso and core to slam.

name: Medicine Ball Rotational Wall Throws
instructions: Stand perpendicular to wall holding ball at hip.
Rotate hips and torso explosively to throw ball against wall.
Catch rebound and reload into hip.
formTips: Pivot back foot to generate power.

name: Explosive V-Ups
instructions: Lie flat on back with legs straight.
Explosively lift legs and upper body simultaneously to touch toes.
Lower back down under control.
formTips: Keep legs as straight as possible.

name: Foam Rolling
instructions: Place target muscle group on foam roller.
Slowly roll back and forth over muscle belly.
Pause on tender spots for 20-30 seconds.
formTips: Breathe deeply to allow tissue relaxation.
Avoid rolling directly over joints or bones.

name: Lacrosse Ball / Massage Ball Work
instructions: Place massage ball under tight trigger point.
Apply localized pressure against wall or floor.
Hold and gently oscillate across muscle knots.

name: Percussion Therapy (Massage Gun)
instructions: Turn on massage gun to comfortable frequency.
Glide attachment head smoothly back and forth along muscle tissue.
Avoid bony prominences.
formTips: Do not push hard into muscle.
commonMistakes: Pressing gun too deep into tissue

name: Dry Sauna
instructions: Sit comfortably inside sauna set to 175-195°F (80-90°C).
Stay for 15-20 minutes while maintaining hydration.
Exit and cool down gradually.
formTips: Listen to body cues if overheating.

name: Infrared Sauna
instructions: Relax in infrared sauna cabin set to 120-150°F (50-65°C).
Remain seated for 20-30 minutes.
Cool down and rehydrate post-session.
formTips: Sip water throughout session if permitted.

name: Hot Epsom Salt Bath
instructions: Dissolve 1-2 cups of Epsom salts into warm/hot bath water.
Submerge body for 15-20 minutes.
Rinse with clean water and dry.
formTips: Keep water comfortably warm, not scalding.
commonMistakes: Soaking in water that is too hot

name: Cold Water Immersion (Ice Bath)
instructions: Submerge body up to chest in 50-59°F (10-15°C) water.
Control breath with steady slow exhales.
Remain submerged for 10-15 minutes.
formTips: Focus on slow breathing to combat shock response.
commonMistakes: Staying submerged beyond safe time limits

name: Contrast Hydrotherapy
instructions: Alternate between 3 minutes hot water and 1 minute cold water.
Repeat sequence 3-4 times.
Always finish with cold shower or dip.
formTips: Ensure hot water is safe and non-scalding.
commonMistakes: Rapid panic breathing in cold water

name: Zone 1 Flush Spin
instructions: Pedal light stationary bike at very low intensity (Zone 1 heart rate).
Maintain cadence around 80-90 RPM.
Spin continuously for 15-30 minutes.
commonMistakes: Spiking heart rate out of Zone 1

name: Aquajogging / Pool Walking
instructions: Walk or jog through waist-to-chest deep pool water.
Use exaggerated running mechanics against water resistance.
Maintain light, fluid rhythm.

name: Light Recovery Walk
instructions: Walk at an easy, casual pace on flat ground.
Maintain relaxed posture and steady breathing.
Walk for 20-45 minutes.

name: Dynamic Mobility Flows (90/90s, World's Greatest Stretch)
instructions: Transition fluidly through 90/90 hip switches and thoracic lunges.
Pause briefly at end ranges of motion.
Breathe through smooth rotational movements.

name: Down-Regulation Breathwork (Box Breathing, Physiological Sighs)
instructions: Inhale through nose for 4s, hold 4s, exhale through mouth 4s, hold 4s.
Or perform double inhale through nose followed by long slow exhale.
Repeat for 5-10 minutes.
formTips: Expand belly on inhale rather than chest.

name: Non-Sleep Deep Rest (NSDR) / Yoga Nidra
instructions: Lie flat on back in quiet room.
Follow audio body-scan recording keeping mind awake while body rests.
Remain still for 10-20 minutes.

name: Pneumatic Compression Boots
instructions: Zip legs into compression boots.
Select pressure level and cycle mode.
Relax in seated or reclined position for 20-30 minutes.

name: Legs-Up-The-Wall Pose
instructions: Lie on back with hips near wall.
Extend legs vertically up wall resting heels against surface.
Relax arms at sides and hold position for 5-15 minutes.
formTips: Place pillow under hips if hamstrings feel tight.
commonMistakes: Placing hips too close if hamstrings strain

name: Norwegian 4×4 VO₂ Max Intervals
instructions: Run/spin 4 minutes at 85-95% max heart rate.
Follow with 3 minutes active recovery at 60-70% max heart rate.
Repeat for 4 total work intervals.
formTips: Maintain consistent pace across all 4 intervals.
Pace active recovery to drop heart rate.

name: Zone 2 Runs
instructions: Run at steady conversational pace (60-70% max heart rate).
Maintain comfortable nasal breathing standard.
Sustain pace for 30 to 60+ minutes.
formTips: Keep stride light and fast cadence.
Slow down if heart rate spikes.
commonMistakes: Running too fast out of Zone 2

name: High-Knee Sprints
instructions: Sprint forward driving knees up to waist level at maximum turnover rate.
Pump arms vigorously opposite to legs.
Maintain upright posture.

name: Burpees
instructions: Drop into push-up position from standing stance.
Perform push-up chest to floor.
Kick feet back under hips and jump upward explosively with arms overhead.
formTips: Keep core engaged during push-up phase.

name: Jump Squats
instructions: Lower into parallel bodyweight squat.
Drive through heels to leap vertically.
Absorb landing softly back into squat position.

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Start in high push-up plank position.
Drive alternate knees rapidly toward chest in running movement.
Maintain flat hips and steady core support.

name: Lateral Skater Hops
instructions: Leap laterally off outer leg landing softly on opposite leg.
Sweep trailing leg behind body with arm motion like a speed skater.
Bounding back and forth rhythmically.

name: Speed Rope (Jumping Rope)
instructions: Hold rope handles at waist level.
Turn rope with wrist rotation while bouncing lightly on balls of feet.
Maintain quick rapid double-unders or single bounces.
commonMistakes: Rotating arms from shoulders instead of wrists

name: Kettlebell Swings
instructions: Hinge hips back to swing kettlebell between legs.
Snap hips forward explosively to drive kettlebell to chest level.
Allow kettlebell to fall back into hip hinge smoothly.
formTips: Movement is a hip hinge, not a squat.

name: Shuttle Runs (Suicides)
instructions: Sprint to first cone/line, touch floor, and sprint back to start line.
Immediately turn and sprint to second cone, back, and so forth.
Maintain high speed transitions.
formTips: Drop center of gravity when changing directions.
Drive off outside foot during turns.

name: Rowing Machine / Assault Bike Sprints
instructions: Execute maximal wattage sprint on rower or air bike for 20-30 seconds.
Rest or pedal slowly during recovery interval.
Maintain stroke power or RPM.
formTips: Push hard through legs before pulling with upper body.
commonMistakes: Pulling early with arms on rower

name: 100m / 200m Flying Sprints
instructions: Build up acceleration over 20-30m run-in zone.
Hit maximum velocity and maintain top speed over 20-30m fly zone.
Decelerate smoothly.
commonMistakes: Tensing shoulders and neck at top speed

name: Hill Sprints
instructions: Sprint uphill at maximum effort over 20-50 meters.
Walk down slowly for full recovery before next rep.
formTips: Drive knees high up hill incline.

name: Sled Pushes / Sled Pull Sprints
instructions: Grip sled upright poles with low body angle.
Drive feet backward aggressively into floor to accelerate sled.
Sprint 15-30 meters.
formTips: Maintain rigid straight line from head to back heel.

name: Resistance Band Sprints
instructions: Attach heavy resistance band around waist anchored behind.
Sprint forward against band tension driving legs powerfully.
Maintain sprint forward angle.

name: A-Skips and B-Skips
instructions: Perform rhythmical skipping motion driving knee up to 90 degrees (A-skip).
For B-skip, extend lower leg forward from 90 degrees before clawing foot back.
Travel forward 15-20 meters.

name: High Knees & Butt Kicks
instructions: Run forward rapidly alternate driving knees to waist level.
Transition into pulling heels straight up to contact glutes under hips.
Perform over 20m distance.
commonMistakes: Kicking heels backward behind body rather than up under glutes

name: Acceleration Wall Drills
instructions: Lean against wall at 45-degree angle with hands placed on wall.
Drive one knee up forcefully in flexed sprinting posture.
Perform rapid leg exchanges driving ball of foot into floor.
formTips: Keep body line straight from head to back heel.
Triple extend ankle, knee, and hip.

name: Falling Starts
instructions: Stand tall on toes.
Lean forward at ankles without bending waist until balance is lost.
Explode out into a 10-15 meter acceleration sprint.
formTips: Let gravity pull body forward before first step.
Drive arms violently on first foot strike.

name: Bounds & Single-Leg Bounding
instructions: Perform oversized bounding running steps focused on vertical projection and distance.
Drive lead knee high and forcefully extend back leg.
Bound across 20-30 meters.
formTips: Maximize air time on each bound.
Plow through ground with active foot strike.

name: Shuttle Runs / Cone Agility Drills
instructions: Set up cones in T-shape or grid pattern.
Sprint forward, shuffle laterally, backpedal around cones at maximum speed.
Stay low through directional changes.
formTips: Plant foot firmly when changing velocity.

name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie flat on the bench.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower under control to mid-chest.
Press until elbows are extended.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust seat height so handles align with lower/mid chest.
Press handles forward until arms are almost fully extended.
Return handles under control without letting weights slam.
formTips: Press back firmly into seat cushion.

name: Machine Row
instructions: Sit with chest braced against pad.
Grip handles with arms extended.
Pull handles toward abdomen squeezing shoulder blades.
Extend arms back under control.
formTips: Keep chest flat against pad throughout movement.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at waist with knees slightly bent and back flat.
Grip barbell overhand wider than shoulder width.
Pull bar to lower sternum/navel.
Lower bar under control.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Rack bar at shoulder height.
Unrack bar resting on collarbones, grip just outside shoulders.
Press bar straight overhead until arms lock out.
Lower under control back to shoulders.
formTips: Move head back slightly as bar passes face.
commonMistakes: Pressing bar forward away from body

name: Incline DB Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline.
Sit back with dumbbells at chest level.
Press dumbbells upward until arms extend fully.
Lower controlled to upper chest height.
commonMistakes: Bench incline set too steep (>45 deg)

name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Attach rope or bar to high pulley.
Grip attachment with elbows locked at sides.
Push attachment down until elbows lock fully.
Return slowly to 90 degrees elbow bend.
commonMistakes: Letting elbows flare or swing forward

name: EZ Bar Curl
instructions: Stand tall holding EZ bar on angled grips.
Keep elbows pinned at sides and curl weight upward toward shoulders.
Lower under control to straight arms.

name: Cable Row
instructions: Sit facing cable machine with feet on footrests.
Grip handle attachment with arms extended and back straight.
Pull handle to abdomen squeezing shoulder blades.
Extend arms back slowly.

name: DB Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on vertical bench with dumbbells held at ear height.
Press dumbbells upward until arms extend overhead.
Lower dumbbells under control to shoulder line.
formTips: Keep core engaged flat to bench backrest.
Avoid clinking dumbbells together at top.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit in machine with thighs secured under pads.
Grip wide bar with overhand grip.
Pull bar down to upper chest while depressing shoulder blades.
Return bar under control to full arm extension.
commonMistakes: Leaning back excessively into horizontal pull

name: Pec Deck
instructions: Sit back against machine with arms bent at 90 degrees on pads or handles.
Bring handles together in front of chest squeezing pectorals.
Return arms outward under control until stretch is felt.
formTips: Keep chest puffed and shoulders back.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Sit facing pec deck machine chest against pad.
Grip handles with arms extended forward.
Pull handles out to sides squeezing rear delts.
Return to start position under control.
formTips: Focus squeeze on back of shoulders.

name: Cable Lateral Raises
instructions: Stand next to low cable pulley holding handle across body.
Raise arm sideways out to shoulder height with slight elbow bend.
Lower under control back across torso.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Attach rope/bar to pulley facing away from machine.
Hold attachment overhead with elbows pointing forward.
Extend arms upward until triceps lock out.
Lower weight behind head slowly.
formTips: Keep upper arms locked in place.
Maintain core bracing to avoid spine arch.

name: Cable Curl
instructions: Stand facing low pulley holding straight or EZ bar handle.
Keep elbows tight to ribs and curl weight up to chest.
Lower bar under control.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Position bar across upper back traps.
Unrack bar and step back with feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower hips back and down until thighs reach parallel.
Drive through heels to stand back up.
formTips: Keep chest lifted and core braced.
Ensure knees track in line with toes.

name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
instructions: Stand holding barbell at hip height with soft knee bend.
Hinge at hips pushing glutes backward while lowering bar along thighs.
Lower until hamstring stretch is felt, then drive hips forward to stand.
formTips: Keep bar close to legs throughout motion.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in leg press sled with feet hip-width apart on platform.
Release safety latches and lower sled until knees form 90 degrees.
Press platform back up driving through heels.
formTips: Keep lower back flat against seat.
Do not lock knees completely at top.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Sit in machine with pad secured above knees and lower lever pad against calves.
Flex knees to pull lower pad downward behind legs.
Return slowly to extended knee position.
commonMistakes: Allowing hips to slide forward off seat

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Position shoulder pads on shoulders with balls of feet on block.
Lower heels into deep stretched position.
Drive up onto toes as high as possible squeezing calves.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand facing away from bench, place top of rear foot on bench behind you.
Lower front thigh to parallel with floor keeping chest tall.
Drive through front heel to return to standing.
formTips: Maintain tall torso with slight hip hinge.
commonMistakes: Placing front foot too close to bench

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit with back flat against pad and lower shin against pad attachment.
Extend knees to lift weight up until legs are straight.
Lower under control to starting bend.
formTips: Align knee joint with machine pivot axis.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on floor with upper back against bench and barbell over hips.
Plant feet flat on floor shoulder-width apart.
Drive hips up through heels until torso and thighs form straight horizontal line.
Lower hips under control.
commonMistakes: Arching lower back instead of hinging hips

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel in front of cable pulley with rope attachment held beside head.
Flex spine downward pulling elbows toward knees using abs.
Return under control allowing spine to extend slightly.
formTips: Keep hips static; flex through spine.
commonMistakes: Sitting back onto heels using bodyweight
Pulling with arms instead of abs

name: Push-Ups
instructions: Set up in high plank with hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower chest to floor keeping elbows at 45 degrees.
Press through palms back to locked plank.

name: Pike Push-Ups
instructions: Form inverted V-shape pike position with hips high.
Lower top of head forward toward ground between hands.
Press back up along diagonal path to starting pike.
formTips: Look back at feet during press.
Keep legs straight if hamstring mobility allows.
commonMistakes: Lowering head straight down instead of forward tripod angle

name: Dips
instructions: Mount dip station with arms locked out.
Lower body until elbows reach 90-degree angle.
Press body straight back up to full lockout.
formTips: Lean torso forward slightly for chest focus.

name: Pull-Ups
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar with overhand grip wider than shoulders.
Pull chest up to bar pulling elbows down to ribs.
Lower back down under control to dead hang.

name: Chin-Ups
instructions: Grip bar underhand shoulder-width apart.
Pull body up until chin clears bar.
Lower under control to full arm stretch.

name: Inverted Rows
instructions: Hang under low bar or rings with heels on floor.
Pull chest up to bar keeping body in straight plank.
Lower back down smoothly.
formTips: Puff chest up to touch bar.

name: Pistol Squats
instructions: Balance on one leg extending opposite leg straight forward.
Squat down fully on stance leg until hamstrings touch calf.
Drive back up to standing.

name: Bulgarian Split Squats (Bodyweight)
instructions: Place rear foot on bench behind you.
Lower front knee to 90 degrees using bodyweight.
Drive back up to standing single-leg position.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curls
instructions: Kneel with ankles anchored behind.
Lower body forward under eccentric control resisting with hamstrings.
Catch hands lightly on floor, push off slightly, and curl back up.
formTips: Control eccentric descent as slow as possible.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raises
instructions: Stand on step edge with heels hanging off.
Lower heels into stretch.
Raise up onto toes fully and squeeze.

name: Hanging Leg Raises
instructions: Hang from pull-up bar with dead hang grip.
Raise straight legs up until parallel or touching bar.
Lower legs slowly without swinging.
formTips: Curler pelvis upward at top of movement.

name: L-Sits
instructions: Press hands down into parallettes or floor extending arms.
Lift legs straight out parallel to ground forming L-shape.
Hold position steady.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold high push-up or forearm plank posture.
Keep spine rigid in straight horizontal line.
Brace core muscles tight.

name: Dragon Fly
instructions: Lie on bench gripping behind head.
Lift entire body up vertically resting on shoulder blades.
Lower straight body down slowly keeping line rigid until above bench.

name: Leg Raises
instructions: Lie on back with legs extended.
Raise legs vertically up to 90 degrees.
Lower legs slowly back down toward floor without arching back.
formTips: Press lower back into ground flat.

name: Weighted Pull-ups
instructions: Attach weight belt with weight plate around waist.
Grip bar wider than shoulder width.
Pull chest to bar and lower controlled to dead hang.

name: Reverse Hyperextensions
instructions: Lie face down on bench with legs hanging off edge.
Contract glutes and hamstrings to raise straight legs up horizontal.
Lower legs slowly back down.
formTips: Do not hyperextend lower back excessively.

name: 400m Build-Ups (Slow Jogging to Sprinting)
instructions: Begin jogging at slow easy pace over 100m.
Gradually increase speed every 100m ending in 90% sprint effort over final stretch.
formTips: Focus on gradual progression of speed.

name: Arm Circles
instructions: Stand tall with arms extended outward at shoulder height.
Rotate arms forward in circular motions starting small and expanding.
Reverse circle direction.

name: Shoulder Swirls / Hugs
instructions: Swing arms horizontally wide apart stretching chest.
Cross arms in front of chest hugging upper back rhythmically.
Alternate top arm on each crossover.

name: Torso Twists
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Rotate torso side to side allowing arms to swing loosely.
Pivot feet naturally as body rotates.

name: Cat-Cow Stretches
instructions: On all fours, arch back upward tucking chin (Cat).
Inhale and drop belly down lifting head and tailbone (Cow).
Flow back and forth steadily.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
instructions: Lunge forward with right foot, placing left hand on floor.
Reach right elbow down inside right instep.
Rotate right arm overhead toward ceiling opening chest, then push back onto heel to stretch hamstrings.
formTips: Keep back leg straight and active.
commonMistakes: Letting back knee touch ground continuously

name: Hip Circles
instructions: Stand on one leg, lift opposite knee to 90 degrees.
Rotate knee outward in large circular path.
Complete reps and reverse circle direction.

name: Leg Swings (Front-to-Back & Side-to-Side)
instructions: Hold onto wall or pole for support.
Swing one leg dynamically front to back expanding range smoothly.
Turn facing wall and swing leg side to side across body.
formTips: Increase height naturally with each swing.
commonMistakes: Arching lower back dramatically on backward swing

name: Bodyweight Squats
instructions: Stand feet hip-width apart.
Sit hips back down until thighs reach parallel.
Drive through feet to stand up.

name: Walking Lunges with a Twist
instructions: Step forward into a lunge bending both knees to 90 degrees.
Rotate torso over front thigh.
Rotate back to center and step into next lunge stride.

name: Inchworms
instructions: Stand tall, hinge at waist to touch hands to floor with straight legs.
Walk hands forward out into high plank position.
Walk feet forward toward hands using short ankle steps to return to standing fold.
formTips: Keep legs as straight as hamstring mobility permits.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms at sides.
Jump feet out wide while clapping hands overhead simultaneously.
Jump back to starting posture.
formTips: Land softly on balls of feet.

name: High Knees (Warm Up)
instructions: Jog in place bringing knees up to hip height.
Pump arms rhythmically with movement.
Maintain light quick foot contacts.

name: Butt Kicks (Warm Up)
instructions: Jog in place pulling heels straight up to make light contact with glutes.
Keep thighs perpendicular to floor.
Maintain rapid foot speed.
